title: land --wait-merge does not count the time a landing waits for the landing lock, so a merged request is not reported as a timeout
goal: the wait-merge bound of backlog.py land starts after the landing holds the landing lock for its second pass, so a landing whose merge request merged during the queue is not refused at step wait-merge after 1800 seconds

run: import sys;t=open("_tools/bl_land.py").read();s=t.split("def wait_merge")[1][:1500];sys.exit(0 if "landing lock" in s else 1)
